en.title: Competitor research
en.description: Turn competitor websites into structured profiles with traceable sources.
tasks: Turn competitor websites into structured profiles with traceable sources.
prerequisites: An AI agent that can read local Skill files. Provide your task context and source materials.
The upstream workflow uses Firecrawl and DataForSEO MCP tools; configure those services and account access first.
en.example: Use competitor-profiling for this task: Turn competitor websites into structured profiles with traceable sources. First ask me for the missing context. Use only the evidence I provide or sources you can verify, and explain what I should check in the result.
en.expectedResult: A task-specific draft or analysis, with assumptions, evidence gaps, and clear next steps for you to review.
limitations: Review factual claims and proposed actions before relying on the output.
Source and package checks are complete; no end-to-end Agent task verification is claimed.
Related skills mentioned upstream are optional separate workflows; they are not automatically installed. Marketing examples and numerical claims need independent verification.

zh.title: 竞品调研
zh.description: 将竞品网站资料整理为可追溯的结构化档案。
tasks: 将竞品网站资料整理为可追溯的结构化档案。
prerequisites: 可读取本地 Skill 文件的 AI Agent；准备任务背景与原始材料。
上游流程使用 Firecrawl 和 DataForSEO MCP 工具，需要提前配置服务与账号权限。
zh.example: 请使用 competitor-profiling 完成以下任务：将竞品网站资料整理为可追溯的结构化档案。 先询问缺少的背景信息，只使用我提供的证据或可以核验的来源，并说明结果需要检查哪些内容。
zh.expectedResult: 得到针对任务的草稿或分析，包含假设、证据缺口和可供检查的后续步骤。
limitations: 使用输出前核对事实依据和建议操作。
已完成来源与包文件检查，尚未声明完成 Agent 端到端任务验证。
上游提到的相关 Skills 属于独立流程，不会自动安装。营销案例和数值结论需自行核验。
